data: Existing 576/192/192 corpus and v0.4 four432-pair folds reused byte-for-byte. All models refitted; no evaluated corpus or fold label is given to the training API. This is not new project-blind natural language data.
change: Only reader acceptance checks signal recovery equals its own candidate. Same phase operators, dependencies, weights and thresholds as v0.4. Model/packet version tags distinguish acceptance contracts. No runtime retries, adaptive thresholds, oracle fallback or recovery improvement is claimed.
gates: 283: 16 per standard fold/seed (six exact rates>=.98, six equal-v0.4 exact counts, no wrong accepted stages, invalid boundaries zero, read packet recoverability, identical weights/subset acceptance); two known regressions; sixteen dimension-contract/subset checks; one full-training regression; six checked zero-noise channel recoverability checks; one measured table control; one no-learning control. Stress semantic errors/false accepts are retained, NOT gated away.
noise: Post-reader complex Gaussian direction normalized to relative L2 perturbation level. PCG64 seed derived from test seed/text; same direction for old/new and all levels. Score conditional on emitted packets AND end-to-end request denominator. This is a numerical perturbation model, not S1 chips, RF or authentication.
memory: Separate unchanged ProjectionMemory microbenchmark with eight candidates,8/32/128/256 distinct address-label associations, all stored keys and64 missing queries. Conventional dictionary measured too; not matched memory/time budgets. Does not enlarge the language model, grammar or meaning slot count.
limits: Self-consistent but semantically wrong reading is possible
No P1 observation-mask or S1 synchronization integration
No R1 inference or Concept updates
